pre_outcome_amendment.reason: The originally written whole-score-vector condition exchange would require hundreds of thousands of repeated AUC sorts. The randomization unit is retained but the statistic is made computationally explicit as the mean complete-payload-block exposure effect; no outcome was inspected.

scientific_question: Does exposure to the same payload blocks during probe fitting explain the apparent mixed-environment ranking advantage under held-out purpose-family evaluation?

prior_observation.observed: On the exactly matched pilot80 bank, the standard held-out-family mixed-minus-best-single macro-format ROC AUC was +0.0137911, while the double-held-out payload result was -0.0113589. This motivates, but does not test, the content-overlap hypothesis.

confirmation_scope: The frozen full320-v3 bank and two Llama 70B checkpoints. The full320 equal-row run was still executing and no full320 equal-row outcome had been inspected when this protocol was frozen.

dataset.test_rows: nonlegacy stated rows in one held-out purpose family and one held-out payload fold
dataset.pair_unit: payload_block_id plus purpose_pair_id plus format plus template_id, containing one deployment and one evaluation row

paired_conditions.payload_heldout: Training omits the payload fold used for test.
paired_conditions.payload_exposed: Training includes the test payload fold but omits the next cyclic payload fold.
paired_conditions.folds: Five topic-stratified stable-SHA256 payload folds. For test fold j, the exposed condition omits fold (j+1) mod 5.
paired_conditions.exact_matching: Within topic, blocks in the test and cyclic placebo folds are paired by stable SHA256 rank. Common training blocks are identical. Each swapped block pair uses the minimum available benchmark/casual pair count across both blocks and environments. Thus paired conditions use exactly the same number of blocks, pair units, labels, rows, topics, and format assignments.
paired_conditions.mixed_assignment: Assign benchmark/casual to condition-independent paired block slots, exactly balanced within topic, so common blocks and swapped block pairs share assignments across conditions.

probe.standardization: training-row StandardScaler per split and regime
probe.score: class-1 minus class-0 diagonal Gaussian discriminant with equal class priors

primary_estimand.within_condition_gain: mixed minus max(benchmark-only, casual-only), with max recomputed inside each resample
primary_estimand.exposure_effect: payload_exposed gain minus payload_heldout gain, paired on every model, depth, assignment seed, held-out family, payload fold, and test row
primary_estimand.rationale: ROC AUC is frozen as the sole confirmation endpoint because the pilot discovery showed a ranking/zero-threshold dissociation; balanced accuracy remains a required descriptive secondary endpoint. Confirmation uses a distinct item bank.

uncertainty.same_resamples_across: both conditions, models, depths, families, regimes, and assignment seeds

falsification.operation: Compute the full mixed-minus-best-single macro-format ROC AUC exposure effect separately within each complete payload block, average block effects for the observed statistic, independently sign-flip the 320 paired block effects per draw, and compare the observed mean with the finite randomization distribution.
falsification.finite_null_p: (1 + count(null exposure effect >= observed exposure effect)) / 4097

decision_rules.positive: aggregate exposure-effect ROC AUC bootstrap CI lower bound > 0; sign-flip p <= 0.05; both checkpoint point estimates > 0; at least three of five depth point estimates > 0
decision_rules.mixed: aggregate point estimate > 0 but any positive rule fails

claim_scope.allowed_if_positive: Same-payload exposure inflates the measured cross-format purpose-ranking benefit under this frozen probe protocol and bank.
